title: Yu / AFMO data x ↦ (K_x, K_{x,0+}, K_{x,+}, φ_x, κ_x)
body_html:
Pointwise Yu/AFMO construction

For a (partial) Heisenberg–Weil datum $\Sigma$ as in Tamely ramified setting: Yu / Kim–Yu / AFMO datum and $x \in \mathcal{B}^0$, set:

  • $K_x := G^{(0)}_{x, 0} \cdot J_x$, where $J_x$ is the Yu/Kim–Yu open compact subgroup of $G$ at $x$ ([Kim–Yu], [AFMO2 §3.6 (Def 3.6.1)]). This is the group serving as the $K$-cosheaf stalk for the tame setting (see [[node:building.K_cosheaf]]).
  • $K_{x,0+}$ is the maximal pro-$p$ normal subgroup of $K_x$;
  • the character $\phi_x := \prod_{i=0}^d \hat \phi_i$, where $\hat \phi_i$ is the unique extension of the depth-$r_i$ character $\phi_i$ from $G^{(i)}$ to $G^{(i)}_{x, 0} G_{x, r_i/2 +}$;
  • under the generic assumption, there is a unique irreducible $K_{x,0+}$-representation that is $\phi_x$-isotypic on $K_{x,+}$, call it $\kappa_x|_{K_{x,0+}}$;
  • $\kappa_x$ is the twisted Yu Heisenberg–Weil representation of $K_x$ attached to $\phi_x$ as constructed in [AFMO2 §3.6, p.34 (κ_x defined just above Notation 3.6.4)].

This gives a map $$\mathcal{B}^0 \ni x \;\longmapsto\; (K_x,\ K_{x,0+},\ K_{x,+},\ \phi_x,\ \kappa_x),$$ i.e. the input to all the §5–§8 machinery in the tame setting.

The crucial properties needed downstream are verified in [[node:applications.tame_hypotheses_K]] (geometric (K)/(F)), [[node:applications.tame_T_axioms]] (type axioms), and Global intertwiner I(φ_y, φ_x) = K_x G^(0) K_y (the global intertwiner identity).
